what_happened: Focused protected-component backend tests ran locally after immutable registration binding, pre-write allowlist validation, audit-hook filesystem/network/subprocess denial, CPU/wall-time enforcement, and Darwin fail-closed memory handling were added.

verification.command: uv run pytest tests/test_components.py && uv run ruff check services/components/execution.py services/components/registry.py services/components/review.py tests/test_components.py

limitations: On Darwin, Python cannot reliably enforce the required in-process memory limit; protected execution fails closed before a handler runs.
This does not establish OS- or process-isolated execution for native dependency code.
No official challenge data, test rows, hidden labels, or Kaggle submission were accessed.
